About Ava Digital Agency

Our Story

Ava Digital Agency was founded in Glen Ellyn, Illinois with a simple mission: help local businesses harness the power of AI-driven digital marketing to achieve real, measurable growth.

Meet Glen Patel, Founder

Glen Patel founded Ava Digital Agency after spending over a decade in the digital marketing industry. He noticed a gap in the market: big agencies offered sophisticated tools but lacked the personal touch and local knowledge that small businesses needed.
